text:
Gold Price in 1998
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1998, the LBMA gold price fell 5.6% between 1998-01-30 ($305) and 1998-12-30 ($288). The highest sampled price was $311 in April and the lowest was $273 in August. The mean of these observations was $295. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
